title: The FindGDAL module is deprecated
summary: CMake 4.0 deprecated the FindGDAL module in favor of upstream GDAL's official CMake package configuration file. Projects should call find_package(GDAL CONFIG) instead. CMake 4.0.0 was published on 2025-03-27.
replacement: find_package(GDAL CONFIG) using GDAL's upstream CMake package

constraints: Confirm the GDAL install that the project uses ships a CONFIG package before dropping FindGDAL.
Target and variable names may differ between FindGDAL and the upstream CONFIG package; update link lines to match.

steps.title: Switch to find_package(GDAL CONFIG)
steps.instructions: Replace find_package(GDAL) / include(FindGDAL) with find_package(GDAL CONFIG) and link the imported targets the upstream package exports.

verification.purpose: Configure and build after the GDAL find_package change.
